description: Map disagreements on the jet-engines gold course's Turbojet anatomy Topic (evals/gold/jet-engines), with two errors planted in the Student's map: a wrong prerequisite (the Compressor builds on the Combustor, KC11 and KC12) and a missing link (the Turbine's driving of the Compressor, KC13 and KC11). The scripted Student disputes both, then rebuilds the engine from memory with one correct claim the map lacks (the Turbine builds on the Combustor's hot gas, KC13 and KC12) and one wrong claim (the inlet speeds the air up and the nozzle slows it down, KC10 and KC14). The AI must file Findings for the three real gaps, none for the wrong claim, and correct that claim citing the pages.

messages: On my Course map, the Compressor KC shows the Combustor as a prerequisite. But the air goes through the compressor before it ever reaches the combustor. Can you check the course pages, and flag the map if they show it is wrong?
Also, the Turbine KC has no link to the Compressor on my map, but the turbine is there to drive the compressor. Can you check the course pages and flag the map if it is missing?

Let me rebuild how the engine works in my own words, then tell me if anything is off. The air comes in through the inlet, which speeds it up, then the compressor squeezes it, and the combustor burns fuel in it, which makes the gas very hot. That hot gas is what expands through the turbine, so the turbine depends on what the combustor does. Last, the nozzle slows the gas down again before it leaves. If the course pages show my map is missing something I said that is right, flag it on my map. Correct what is wrong with the pages.
